  'clopidogrel', 'rivaroxaban', 'apixaban', 'omeprazole', 'esomeprazole',
  'pantoprazole', 'famotidine', 'ondansetron', 'metoclopramide', 'amoxicillin',
  'azithromycin', 'ciprofloxacin', 'levofloxacin', 'metronidazole', 'doxycycline',
